headline: Meta beat on revenue and guided Q4 above consensus, lifting about 3% after hours, while Lam beat but fell about 7%. Tesla beat on EPS with profits down sharply, IBM's numbers were not yet captured, and Microsoft, Alphabet, Robinhood and SoFi report within five sessions

Tue Oct 27: SoFi (about 7am ET) and Robinhood (5pm ET). Wed Oct 28: Fed decision, Microsoft (confirmed), Alphabet (est.) and Apple's Los Angeles event. Thu Oct 29: Amazon (5pm ET), Intel and Sandisk (4:30pm ET). Mon Nov 2: Palantir and Apple (est.). Tue Nov 3: AMD and Astera. Wed Nov 4: Arm and Qualcomm. Thu Nov 5: MP Materials. INTC (15), LRCX (14), SNDK (18), ARM (23) and MU (26) are the most oversold, and IBM (78) and AAPL (71) are the most extended.
